note: Vocab-filtered control: short-regime training on the original text filtered to the top-25k replacement vocabulary at the 10% token budget (as-ran data fraction 0.202 of the filtered corpus), 3 seeds per model size. Values are each run's end-of-training full-BLiMP (1000 pairs per paradigm) best-temperature accuracy evaluated on the EMA weights (the trainer's final test-evaluation block).
